faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium headset spacer?

faq.q: How is a titanium headset spacer manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium headset spacer is manufactured using Hot forging; CNC turning; Thread rolling (DIN 13-1 / ISO 965-2, 6g). Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium headset spacer?
faq.a: Stainless steel (heavier, less fatigue life), aluminum (lower strength)

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium headset spacer?
